topic: Name as it appears on ID
requirement: Enter your name exactly as it is written on the identification you will present, including any middle name. If the name here does not match the ID you upload later, the application is returned for correction.

Every notice about this application is sent to this address, including the one-time code used at the final step. Use an address you can open now, because the code is needed before the application can be submitted.
Enter an eleven-digit Nigerian mobile number beginning with zero, with no spaces or dashes. A number entered in international form is rejected by the page rather than converted.
A Local Government Area is the administrative division below a state, and the list here only fills in once a state is chosen. Pick the LGA of the address you gave, not the one you were born in.

Choose Sole Proprietorship if you are the only owner, or Partnership if two or more people own the business together. The choice sets which documents are asked for later and cannot be changed after submission.

The code is sent to the email address given on the first step and is entered by you, not filled in for you. This step submits the application, so nothing here is completed automatically and the declaration must be read before it is agreed to.
